newsitem.title: GERMANY: Berlin arrests two suspected in La Belle attack.
newsitem.headline: Berlin arrests two suspected in La Belle attack.

text.p: Berlin justice authorities said on Friday they had arrested two people suspected of involvement in the 1986 bombing of the La Belle nightclub in what was then West Berlin that killed two American servicemen.
A spokesman said a woman and a man were arrested on Thursday. A total of three people were killed in the bombing which directly preceded a U.S. air strike against Libya.

The United States blamed Libya for the 1986 attack and retaliated by bombing Tripoli, killing at least 15 people including an adopted 15-month-old daughter of Colonel Muammar Gaddafi. More than 200 people were wounded in the air attacks.
Two U.S. soldiers and a woman civilian were killed and more than 200 people, including many off-duty U.S. servicemen, were injured by the La Belle bomb.

The Berlin spokesman said those arrested were a 37-year-old woman, suspected of planting the bomb, and her husband at the time, identified only as Ali C., who allegedly gave her instructions for the attack.
